_README: #837 — the join from upstream's ENCHANTMENT names to this catalog's stat vocabulary. Upstream names the mechanic (`Hit Points`); our catalog names the affix (`False Life`). Every `joined` target is asserted to exist in the built catalog. `unmatched` is quarantined, never guessed: a wrong stat name is a wrong stacking bucket, which is invisible once a loadout is solved.
_rejected_rule: A general `recipe-name` FALLBACK for compound recipes was tested and discarded: it maps `Spellcasting Implement` onto `Corrosion`, folding a non-stat into that recipe's spell power and double-counting it. The rule is safe only where the recipe grants exactly one enchantment, which is how the joined entries were derived.

_rules.insightful-prefix: The pipeline has stripped an `Insightful` prefix since #193.
_rules.lore-affix-name: Spell critical chance comes from Lore items.
_rules.recipe-name: The recipe whose ONLY enchantment this is, is itself named with our affix name. Corroborated per entry.
_rules.spell-focus-suffix: `X Spell Focus` is spelled `X Focus` as an item affix.
_rules.spell-power-affix-name: DDO names per-element spell power by affix (`Corrosion` for Acid), which is also upstream's recipe name.
_rules.wiki-dual-shard-table: The wiki's Combined prefixes (dual shard) table names both effects of a recipe. Every yourddo recipe granting this enchantment pairs it with an effect already joined or native, and the wiki names that recipe's other effect `Deception`: Sabotaging (Seeker), Assassin's (Doublestrike), Outlander's (Doubleshot), Relentless (Deadly), Thieving (Accuracy) - five for five, slots matching. Read 2026-09-20 from https://ddowiki.com/page/Essence_Crafting, Combined prefixes.
